rav-acha-bar-adda.name: Rav Aḥa bar Adda
rav-acha-bar-adda.bio: Amora cited in the Talmud, here giving a verse as the source for Rabbi Yoḥanan’s view on interest.
rav-acha-bar-adda.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a greying dark beard and a plain brown wool mantle, quoting a verse with one finger raised; background of mudbrick academy walls lit by oil lamps.

chanan-hamitzri.name: Ḥanan the Egyptian
chanan-hamitzri.bio: Tanna whose ruling on replacing one of the Yom Kippur goats is cited in the Talmud.
chanan-hamitzri.prompt: A sage in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a white linen mantle, a calm, decided expression; background of limestone arches and olive trees in soft evening light.
